breakdown.title: The Brass Key and the Paper Boat
breakdown.logline: A dreamer crosses a grey beach, climbs an impossible lighthouse, receives a paper boat from their father, and leaves it in a field where the sea once was.

colours.value: grey beach, white lighthouse, yellow grass, red tractor

breakdown.world_logic: The lighthouse interior is an endless staircase; the sea can be replaced by a field; the dreamer can instantly be in a far-off tractor.

geography.value: a beach of grey sand, with a lighthouse at the end
a spiral staircase going round and round, with stone walls

landmarks.value: the spiral stone stairs, the rail

geography.value: a round room with windows all around

landmarks.value: the table, the windows, the pile of paper boats

appearance.value: a paper boat folded from newspaper

moments.action: The dreamer walks on a grey beach with their small brown terrier, holding a brass key.
moments.visual_point: the dreamer, dog, and brass key on the grey sand

moments.action: The dreamer looks down the beach toward the white lighthouse at the end.
moments.visual_point: the white, plain lighthouse waiting at the end of the beach

moments.action: The dreamer holds up the brass key, knowing it is for the lighthouse.
moments.looks_at: the brass key in the dreamer's hand
moments.visual_point: the brass key in the dreamer's hand, the lighthouse behind

moments.action: The dog runs ahead up the spiral staircase, disappearing around the bend.
moments.visual_point: the small terrier's paws on the stone steps, just out of sight around the curve

moments.action: The dreamer climbs the spiral staircase, holding the rail, looking up.
moments.visual_point: the dreamer's hand on the rail, the endless spiral above
moments.dream: the staircase is endless, but it feels normal

moments.action: In a round room with windows all around, the father sits at a table folding paper boats from newspaper.
moments.looks_at: the table with the father and the pile of paper boats
moments.visual_point: the father folding a newspaper boat, the pile beside him

moments.action: The dreamer approaches, and the father hands them a paper boat without looking up.
moments.looks_at: the father's hands offering the paper boat
moments.feeling: no fuss, just the next thing

moments.action: The dreamer goes to the window, holding the paper boat.
moments.looks_at: the window with the field of grass outside
moments.visual_point: the dreamer at the window, boat in hand
moments.shift: the sea is gone, replaced by a field of tall yellow grass
moments.dream: the sea has become a field

moments.action: Through the window, the dreamer sees a red tractor moving slowly far off in the tall yellow grass.
moments.looks_at: the red tractor in the field
moments.visual_point: the red tractor as a small toy against the yellow

blocking.front: the window side with the field view

spots.name: the window with the field outside

moments.action: The dreamer sits in the tractor cab next to the silent driver, still holding the paper boat.
moments.looks_at: the driver and the dreamer in the cab
moments.visual_point: the dreamer and the unknown driver side by side, boat in hand
moments.shift: the dreamer is suddenly in the tractor's cab

moments.action: The tractor drives straight through the tall grass, slow and steady.
moments.visual_point: the red tractor moving through an endless yellow field

moments.action: The tractor stops at the edge where the beach had been.
moments.looks_at: the edge of the grass where the beach begins
moments.visual_point: the red tractor at the boundary of grass and grey sand

moments.action: The dreamer gets out and puts the paper boat down in the grass.
moments.looks_at: the paper boat in the grass
moments.feeling: the point of all of it
moments.visual_point: the dreamer's hand setting the paper boat gently down

m10.text: Shot from in front, close, at eye level, looking at the driver, using a 14mm lens. The driver occupies the left third of the picture, seen from the knees up and filling it from top to bottom edge, turned three-quarters toward the camera and looking toward the left. The dreamer occupies the right third, also seen from the knees up and filling it from top to bottom edge, turned three-quarters toward the camera and looking toward the left, holding the paper boat right of center in his hands, the boat filling from low down to the bottom edge. The background is the back of the room. Just off the left edge are the controls; behind the camera is the forward direction of the tractor.
m10.view: Seen from in front of them, close, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks at the driver, toward the back of the room. A 14mm lens. From left to right across the picture: the driver, the left third of the picture, turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking toward the left of the picture, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from its top edge to its bottom edge; then the dreamer, the right third of the picture, turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking toward the left of the picture, holding the paper boat, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from its top edge to its bottom edge. Nobody else is in the picture. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. The paper boat, right of the middle of the picture, in the dreamer's hands, filling the picture from low down to its bottom edge. Outside the picture, off to the left: the controls. Outside the picture, behind the camera: forward direction of the tractor.

m3.text: A 50mm lens at the dreamer's eye level, looking toward the brass key held in the dreamer's hands on the left side of the frame, about 2 metres from the dreamer. In the left third, the brass key fills the picture from its top edge to its bottom edge, in sharp focus. In the middle, the dreamer is seen from the waist up, facing the camera, filling the picture from near its top to its bottom edge, slightly softer than the key. The background is the grey sand of the beach, out of focus, stretching away from the lighthouse. The light is soft, grey daylight from the overcast sky above. Behind the camera, out of frame, is the white lighthouse in the distance.

m1.text: The camera is 4 metres behind the dog and the dreamer, at their eye level, pointed toward the lighthouse in the distance, on a 24mm lens. In the left of the picture, the small brown terrier stands with its back to the camera, its whole body visible from one-third to two-thirds down the picture; to the right of the middle, the dreamer stands with their back to the camera, also whole from one-third to two-thirds down, and holds a brass key in their hands, the key filling the right third of the picture from near the top edge down to the middle. The lighthouse stands in the middle distance at the center of the picture, its upper part filling from the top edge down to one-third, while the dog, dreamer, and key are in sharp focus and the lighthouse is slightly soft. The light is flat grey daylight from the overcast sky above, with no strong shadows. Just outside the edges, the grey beach continues empty; the overcast sky extends above the lighthouse.
